title: CTRES v1.0 R11 Provider Attestation
description: Where money sits in a provider's pooled account, the provider's statement standing in place of the operator's own statements (§4.11). It applies equally to a card acquirer's reserve, a mobile money collection account, an e-money balance and a virtual-asset provider's pooled wallet.

attestation_id.description: Attestation identifier, referenced from R3 and R4 attestation_ref (§4.11).

currency_or_asset.description: Currency or asset of the balances (§4.11; §3 Currency-aware).

opening_balance.description: Balance held for the operator at period start (§4.11).

balance_held_for_operator.description: Balance held for the operator at period end (§4.11).

reference_scheme.description: The reference scheme that links the provider's records to the operator's, for example how provider references map to rail_reference in R3 and R4 (§4.11).

covers_location_ids.description: The R1 funds locations the attestation covers (§4.11).

evidence_ref.description: Where the signed attestation is kept (§4.11).

signature.description: Detached electronic signature over the attestation, where the provider signs electronically (§4.11).
